request.initial_prompt: Both in ancient Egypt and Indostan, the whole body of the people was divided into different casts or tribes each of which was confined, from father to son, to a particular employment, or class of employments. The son of a priest was necessarily a priest; the son of a soldier, a soldier; the son of a labourer, a labourer; the son of a weaver, a weaver; the son of a tailor, a tailor, etc. In both countries, the cast of the priests holds the highest rank, and that of the soldiers the next; and in both countries the cast of the farmers and labourers was superior to the casts of merchants and manufacturers.

raw_segments.text: Both in ancient Egypt and Indostan, the whole body of the people was divided into different casts or tribes each of which was confined, from father to son, to a particular employment, or class of employments.
The son of a priest was necessarily a priest, the son of a soldier, a soldier, the son of a labourer, a labourer, the son of a weaver, a weaver, the son of a tailor, a tailor, etc.

In both countries, the cast of the priests holds the highest rank, and that of the soldiers the next. And in both countries the cast of the farmers and labourers was superior to the casts of merchants and manufacturers.
